fusions.name: Nectar Raid
fusions.desc: Sends a sting into the first enemy in its path for 7 poison damage; it then leaps to 1 more enemy within 3 tiles for 60% of that. You heal for 20% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Waggle Signal
fusions.desc: A droning pulse deals 26 resonating damage to every enemy within 4 tiles and leaves them [Marked] for 10 seconds. Your party deals 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Hive Sharing
fusions.desc: Restores 14 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Night Shift Drone
fusions.desc: A bonded drone familiar flies with you, striking enemies within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second and leaving them [Poisoned] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Each kill restores 2 health to you.
